2014_spells.umbramancy-egw.description: You manipulate shadows around you. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to become invisible until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw.
2014_spells.umbramancy-egw.effectSummary: Make a creature invisible until it attacks or the spell ends
2014_spells.umbramancy-egw.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to become invisible until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. You manipulate shadows around you. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to become invisible until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
